title: Give procedure agents skills: load SKILL.md documents by reference
description: A Tactus Agent gets a system_prompt string and tools; there is no way to hand it a skill document. Papyrus already has skills/newsroom-research-workflow/SKILL.md and the Humanus skill ships as humanus skill. Let a procedure (or an agent block) name skills, from Papyrus, from a site's repository or from the backend, and load them into the agent's instructions, so the same SKILL.md serves Claude Code interactively and the procedure's agent. First use: Distinctive's TTAB ruling-analysis skill.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Correction after reading Tactus: Tactus already has an Agent Skills loader (tactus/skills/loader.py; Agent{ skills = {paths}, skills_mode = "metadata"|"full" }, Tactus-6aa). It has not been exercised by real work, so this task is (1) test it with the TTAB ruling-analysis skill and fix rough edges in Tactus, and (2) the Papyrus part: deliver a site's or Papyrus's SKILL.md files to a run (locally and in the cloud) so the paths resolve.
